findings.evidence_snippet: Every kds-card header renders the elapsed-timer digits (e.g. '15781:', '15779:', '15777:', '15766:') visually overlapping with the queue_number text (e.g. 'A0001', 'A0002'). The 'ATT…' Attente label on the right edge is clipped/truncated by the elapsed-wrap that overflows leftward into the queue display. Observed on ALL 8 visible cards in the 4x2 grid. DOM evidence: <div class="kds-card__main"> contains both .kds-card__queue and .kds-card__elapsed-wrap as siblings; the elapsed digits push into the queue zone instead of stacking right-aligned beside the Attente label.
findings.claim: KDS V2 card header has a flexbox/grid layout defect where the elapsed-timer overflows into the queue_number text region and clips the Attente label. Affects 100% of rendered cards. Chef cannot read the queue number cleanly at a glance — primary information clarity is degraded. The visual collision is consistent across P1/P2/P3/P4/P5/P6/P7/P10 captures (8 of 8 rendering states).
findings.fix_hint: resources/js/components/admin/kitchenDisplaySystem/KdsOrderCard.vue lines 59-79 (.kds-card__main + .kds-card__queue + .kds-card__elapsed-wrap). Likely root cause: .kds-card__elapsed-wrap is not constrained to a fixed max-width and lacks 'flex-shrink: 0' on the queue, or .kds-card__main is missing 'justify-content: space-between' with min-widths. Verify the CSS in the SFC <style> block and ensure elapsed-wrap right-aligns with proper spacing.
